questions.text:
Consider the following statements with regard to India's defence sector transformation (August 2026 report):
1. The overall defence budget increased from ₹2.53 lakh crore in FY 2013-14 to ₹7.85 lakh crore in FY 2026-27.
2. Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) cap in defence is 74% under the Automatic Route.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explanation: Both statements are correct. India's defence budget showed a 3.1-fold growth reaching ₹7.85 lakh crore in FY 2026-27, and FDI is permitted up to 74% under the automatic route (up to 100% via Government route).

questions.text: Exercise Khaan Quest 2026, focused on multilateral peacekeeping under Chapter VII of the UN Charter, was conducted at:
questions.explanation: Exercise Khaan Quest 2026 was conducted at the Five Hills Training Area in Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia, with Indian Army contingents participating.

questions.text: The Pinaka Long Range Guided Rocket (LRGR) successfully flight-tested by DRDO at Chandipur achieved a user-defined minimum operational range of:
questions.explanation: DRDO successfully flight-tested the Pinaka Long Range Guided Rocket (LRGR) at Integrated Test Range, Chandipur, Odisha, validating its 60 km minimum operational range with pinpoint accuracy.

questions.text: Exercise Veer Guardian 2026 is a bilateral air exercise between the Indian Air Force and the air force of which country?
questions.explanation: Exercise Veer Guardian 2026 is conducted between the IAF and the Japan Air Self-Defense Force (JASDF) at Air Force Station Jodhpur, Rajasthan.

questions.text: Which Indian Navy ship participated in the 4th edition of Exercise Samudra Laksamana with the Royal Malaysian Navy at Lumut?
questions.explanation: INS Mysore participated in the 4th edition of Exercise Samudra Laksamana, the bilateral maritime exercise between the Indian Navy and Royal Malaysian Navy at Lumut, Malaysia.

questions.text: India currently ranks where in Asia and globally under the Ramsar Convention for total wetland sites?
questions.explanation: India has the highest number of Ramsar sites in Asia and ranks third globally after the UK and Mexico.

questions.text: Which two Indian cities joined the list of Wetland Accredited Cities in the world?
questions.explanation: Indore (Madhya Pradesh) and Udaipur (Rajasthan) joined the prestigious list of 31 Wetland Accredited Cities globally.

questions.text: The World Circular Economy Forum (WCEF) 2026 was hosted in which Indian city?
questions.explanation: India hosted the 10th edition of the World Circular Economy Forum 2026 at Mahatma Mandir, Gandhinagar, Gujarat, marking its first hosting in South Asia.

questions.text: Patna Bird Sanctuary, newly added to the Ramsar list, is located in which district of Uttar Pradesh?
questions.explanation: Patna Bird Sanctuary is situated in the Etah district of Uttar Pradesh.

questions.text: Which international organisation co-organised the 4th Indo-German Environment Forum where the India-Germany Wetlands Declaration was signed?
questions.explanation: The India-Germany Wetlands Declaration was signed during the 4th IGEF organised by India's MoEFCC and Germany's BMUKN.

questions.text: India's real GDP grew by what percentage in the April–June quarter (Q1 FY27), maintaining its status as the fastest-growing major economy?
questions.explanation: Real GDP grew by 7.8% in Q1 FY27, up from 6.9% in the same quarter last year.

questions.text: What does the term 'Orange Economy', featured in Union Budget 2026-27, primarily represent?
options: Renewable solar and nuclear energy sectors
Economic activities driven by creativity, culture, and intellectual property
questions.explanation: The Orange Economy refers to activities driven by creativity, culture, ideas, and IP value (media, gaming, arts, animation, comics).

questions.text: The Supreme Court launched 'Jan Soochna Seva' on Hindi Diwas (14 September 2026) primarily to:
options: Provide live audio streaming of all court hearings
Deliver simplified information and summaries of important judgments in Hindi
Conduct digital voter registration for general elections
Provide legal aid for rural women
questions.explanation: Jan Soochna Seva provides concise Hindi summaries of selected important Supreme Court judgments in text, audio, and video formats.

questions.text: Which book won the prestigious International Booker Prize 2026?
questions.explanation: 'Taiwan Travelogue' by Yáng Shuāng-zi, translated by Lin King, won the International Booker Prize 2026.

questions.text: The 18th BRICS Summit 2026 was hosted under India's fourth BRICS Chairship at which venue?
questions.explanation: India hosted the 18th BRICS Summit on September 12-13, 2026, at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi, adopting the New Delhi Declaration.
